headline: Breaking! IHSG Opens Up 1.29% Right Away, This Is the Reason
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) opened up 1.29% at 5,283.29. The US dollar also strengthened, and President Prabowo proposed two vice-presidential candidates.
why: The Jakarta Composite is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local equity sentiment and foreign flows.
why_moved: The report links the opening gain to a stronger US dollar and political news, though it gives no detailed mechanism.
original_headline: Breaking! IHSG Dibuka Langsung Menguat 1,29%, Ini Penyebabnya
